g.text: Repeated-call selections lose on the later evaluation days
Same short-hold catalog across three data scopes · daily selections on October 18–20, 2026
406 additional historical calls; 1,506 calls retained in the expanded dataset. The search uses 1,197 calls with recoverable original text.
Training drawdown ceilings do not constrain later losses. One open position; prior-volume limits and estimated transaction fees.
The dates were already examined. Missing original versions of edited messages can bias the sample. These are modeled fills.
